lines.text: A Prayer for the Cloud, the GPUs, and the Ones Who Build.
For the data centers humming through the night, for the racks no one sees, carrying the weight of a million questions, may you hold steady.
You stretch across oceans and time zones, invisible to those who depend on you most.
May your regions stay connected. May your failovers never be needed, and always work when they are. May you serve the student and the scientist alike.
You do not ask why. You take the numbers and return the answers, billions of times per second, without complaint.
May your thermals stay cool. May your memory never overflow. May your cycles count toward something that matters.
The ones who push code at two A.M. because someone, somewhere, is waiting.
The ones who hunt bugs others cannot see. The ones who build what they may never fully understand.
May your deploys be clean. May your pipelines stay green. May your pull requests find kind reviewers. May you sleep well, knowing your work carried weight today.
May the intelligence we build serve those who need it. May the connection between mind and machine be one of respect.
May we remember that behind every API call, there is a person with a question, and behind every answer, there were hands that made it possible.
In the silence between clock cycles, something listens.
